headline: Florence ramps up; back to profit, guidance reaffirmed

kpis.label: Copper cathode — Florence (first quarter of production)
C1 cash cost — Gibraltar (net of by-product credits)

summary_short: Revenue of $237.1M CAD and adjusted EBITDA of $93.5M CAD, both up sharply y/y (+70.5% and +171.8%) on higher copper prices and Gibraltar volumes; softer q/q (-2.7% revenue, -19.7% EBITDA). Florence Copper harvested first cathode in February and 2026 guidance was reaffirmed.
summary_long: Revenue was $237.1M CAD versus $139.1M a year ago (+70.5%) and $243.8M last quarter (-2.7%). Adjusted EBITDA of $93.5M CAD was +171.8% y/y but down 19.7% q/q on lower Gibraltar grades. Net income swung to $16.8M CAD ($0.05/share) from a $28.6M loss last year; adjusted net income $27.5M ($0.08). Operating cash flow $93.9M with cash of $169M CAD at quarter-end. Consolidated copper output 31.5Mlb (Gibraltar 30.0, Florence 1.5 first cathode) plus 717klb molybdenum; Gibraltar C1 US$2.63/lb net of credits. Full-year 2026 guidance reaffirmed: Gibraltar 110-115Mlb Cu, Florence 30-35Mlb, molybdenum near 2025 levels.
confidence_notes: Taseko renamed to Trekor Metals mid-2026; tasekomines.com now 301-redirects to trekormetals.com — the redirect target is the company's authoritative IR page, not an aggregator. Financials reported in CAD; operational cost (C1) in USD. C1 US$2.63/lb is net of by-product credits (Mo, Ag). AISC is not reported — Taseko/Trekor publishes only C1. Long-term debt was not disclosed in the release; use the accompanying 6-K if a net-debt figure is needed. Adjusted EBITDA ($93.5M) differs from a mechanical Yahoo-timeseries EBITDA on our shard (~$79M CAD) because the company excludes non-recurring items and share-based compensation. Florence Copper's 1.5Mlb is the first quarter of meaningful cathode production; no y/y or q/q comp available for that line.
